basic_info.description: The ultimate in elegance and spaciousness A truly remarkable top-floor condo offering the perfect blend of modern elegance and comfort in an elevator building is a rare find in Noe Valley. Its open plan design and unobstructed three sided exposure with south and east facing views invite natural light and fresh air from its massive windows throughout the day. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a perfect space for entertaining. The primary bedroom is serene and features an en-suite bath. With newly refinished maple floors and all new kitchen appliances, ample counter space, a secure parking in a gated garage is an additional bonus to this amazing home.  Enjoy the Noe Valley lifestyle with its urban conveniences where you are always just steps from shops, dining, parks, and public transportation, making your daily life seamless and enjoyable. This prime location offers easy access to public transportation and tech shuttle stops, making your commute to downtown San Francisco and Silicon Valley a breeze. Don't miss out on this extraordinary opportunity to make it your own.
